designNotes.rarityScale: stars is an integer from 1 to 5; 5-star items are intended to be build-defining.
designNotes.naturalMeaning: 'natural' is the equipment affinity for the game's Nature domain.
designNotes.cycleDefinition: A Cycle is one full pass through the ordered spell deck, ending after the Reshuffle.

slotPhilosophy.weapon: Most Weapons have offensive or sequencing abilities and are intended to be build-defining.
slotPhilosophy.ring: Most Rings have synergy, mana-engine, domain, or sequencing abilities and are intended to be build-defining.
slotPhilosophy.armor: Every Armor item grants both maximum Health and maximum Mana. Most of its power budget is in those stats; only selected items carry a small defensive or sustain ability.
slotPhilosophy.boots: Every Boots item grants both maximum Health and maximum Mana. Most of its power budget is in those stats; selected items carry a small tempo, recovery, or sequencing ability.

statFields.spellPowerPct: Percentage modifier to spell direct damage unless the item text says otherwise.
statFields.restorationPct: Percentage modifier to healing done unless the item text says otherwise.
statFields.critChancePct: Percentage-point modifier to base Critical Hit chance.
statFields.critPowerBonusPct: Percentage points added to the normal critical damage multiplier.
statFields.startingWard: Flat Ward granted at combat start.

designNotes.implementationNote: ability.text is player-facing rules text. The remaining ability fields are machine-readable suggestions and can be adapted to the combat-effect schema used by the app.
